purpose: One collapsible section: a trigger with an optional icon, the label and a chevron that flips when open, over its content. It only exists inside an Accordion.

notFor.case: A menu of actions behind a trigger.

Closed.meaning: Content hidden; the person toggles it, the app can control it.
Closed.visual: Icon and chevron Content/secondary, label Content/primary. Fill and edge by variant: none (ghost-default, ghost-rounded), Border/default bottom edge (ghost-underline), Surface/layer-1 with Border/default (outline-rounded, outline-sharp), Surface/muted (filled-rounded).

Open.visual: Content shown in Content/secondary; the chevron flips. ghost-rounded gains Surface/layer-1; outline variants move the edge to Border/strong.

Disabled.visual: Icon, label and chevron Content/disabled; edges move to Border/subtle (ghost-underline, outline variants).

a11y.role: button in a heading, with aria-expanded and aria-controls; the panel is labelled by its trigger
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches the trigger; Space or Enter toggles it; arrows and Home / End move between triggers (Radix Accordion).
a11y.reducedMotion: Expand and collapse become instant (the reduced version of accordion-expand / accordion-collapse in src/lib/motion.ts). The chevron turn on use-disclosure-in under reduced motion is not decided.

openQuestions: Variant=card exists only in Figma; the code API has no card. Build it in code, or remove it from the file?
Reduced motion: should the chevron still turn (use-disclosure-in), or flip at once like the content?
